programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Crímenes sin resolver

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - El experimento
programme.desc: El bebé de Maritza Ramírez es secuestrado el día programado para nacer. En su fiesta de 16 años, los síntomas de la enfermedad de Helen reaparecen. Lumpkin, un pueblo olvidado es la ubicación de una cárcel de inmigrantes.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Radiografía de una masacre
programme.desc: Una familia destruida tras un inesperado ataque con armas de fuego, habla sobre todo el sufrimiento que tuvieron que pasar al perder a sus seres queridos en manos de organizaciones delictivas. Una de las masacres más sangrientas y terribles de México.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Fentanilo la nueva apuesta del narco
programme.desc: México es país productor y de tránsito de Fentanilo, un opioide sintético el cual es cada vez más consumido en Estados Unidos. Esta droga causa muchas muertes entre jóvenes. Un kilo de fentanilo genera las mismas ganancias que una tonelada de cocaína.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Desaparecidos de la frontera
programme.desc: Ante la incompetencia de las autoridades, familiares se han convertido en investigadores privados aficionados dispuestos a enfrentar riesgos, ellos dicen vivir una carrera contra el tiempo para evitar que sus seres queridos desaparezcan para siempre.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - El hijo de El Chapo captura y liberación de un intocable
programme.desc: El ejército mexicano despliega un operativo en Culiacán, Sinaloa para detener a un familiar de Joaquín Guzmán Loera 'El Chapo'. El objetivo es capturado, durante un día Culiacán queda atrapado en un enfrentamiento entre el ejército y los narcos.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Emprendiendo sueños

programme.desc: Steven Rinella and ecologist Karl Malcolm head to the Cibola National Forest, guided by a century-old tip from conservationist Aldo Leopold, to hunt Merriam's wild turkeys. programme.title: MeatEater

During the annual pig roundup, Steve learns about the ecological impact and challenges of controlling the hog population, providing a deeper understanding of the complexities of hunting and wildlife management in the Lone Star State.

programme.title: MeatEater
programme.sub-title: MeatEater - Mountain Memories: Montana Black Bear
programme.desc: Steven Rinella heads deep into Montana's rugged mountains to hunt black bears, reflecting on two decades of memories in this harsh yet captivating landscape. Joined by memories of his brother and their youthful adventures, Steve navigates grizzly country, contemplates the passage of time, and explores the evolving nature of hunting. Through encounters with both bears and the terrain, Steve seeks not just game but a connection to the past and the lessons it holds.

Surrounded by vast public lands and rugged terrain, they navigate the challenges of close-range stalking with their bows. With Joe's enthusiasm for archery and Steve's experience, the duo pushes their limits in pursuit of these wary deer, embracing the highs and lows of hunting in one of America's most unforgiving landscapes.

programme.title: Gruden: A Love Story
programme.desc: Few people love anything more than Jon Gruden loves football. Suzy Kolber digs into the singular obsession that made him a Super Bowl winner, a wildly popular Monday Night Football analyst, and a social media sensation nobody saw coming. Jon reflects on the philosophy that drove every reinvention-including how he's navigated life since his coaching career came to a sudden end-and whether the sideline is still calling.

programme.title: Ice Dreams
programme.desc: Digit Murphy built women's hockey from the bench and the boardroom - coaching, fighting, and lobbying long before the lights came on. Hilary Knight became the face of women's hockey, setting records, winning Olympic gold twice, and carrying a sport on her back. Suzy Kolber sits down with both trailblazers to examine what it costs to love a sport that didn't always love you back.

programme.title: Flag Bearers
programme.desc: Sam Rapoport, a former Canadian quarterback, spent two decades opening the NFL's doors to women - as coaches, scouts, and executives - while laying the groundwork for flag football to go global. Diana Flores, who learned flag football on a dirt field in Mexico City, became the international face of the sport after starring in a Super Bowl commercial. Suzy Kolber huddles with two fiercely determined women who paved flag football's path to the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics - and aren't stopping there.

programme.title: Savannah's Top Banana
programme.desc: Jesse Cole, the visionary owner of the Savannah Bananas, turned a failing college summer baseball team into a $500 million entertainment empire by doing the exact opposite of what everyone else did. Suzy Kolber traces how a man in a yellow tuxedo built a global phenomenon by asking a question nobody else was: What if the fans, and true fun are the whole point? Jesse opens up about being nearly $2 million in debt and the critics who were certain he was out of his mind - right up until he wasn't.

programme.title: Shaquille O'Neal
programme.desc: Shaquille O'Neal, who went from being poor and bullied to NBA stardom, reveals how his stepfather taught him the valuable lesson that "true pressure is not knowing where your next meal is coming from."

programme.title: Gruden: A Love Story
programme.desc: Few people love anything more than Jon Gruden loves football. Suzy Kolber digs into the singular obsession that made him a Super Bowl winner, a wildly popular Monday Night Football analyst, and a social media sensation nobody saw coming. Jon reflects on the philosophy that drove every reinvention-including how he's navigated life since his coaching career came to a sudden end-and whether the sideline is still calling.

programme.title: Ice Dreams
programme.desc: Digit Murphy built women's hockey from the bench and the boardroom - coaching, fighting, and lobbying long before the lights came on. Hilary Knight became the face of women's hockey, setting records, winning Olympic gold twice, and carrying a sport on her back. Suzy Kolber sits down with both trailblazers to examine what it costs to love a sport that didn't always love you back.

programme.title: Flag Bearers
programme.desc: Sam Rapoport, a former Canadian quarterback, spent two decades opening the NFL's doors to women - as coaches, scouts, and executives - while laying the groundwork for flag football to go global. Diana Flores, who learned flag football on a dirt field in Mexico City, became the international face of the sport after starring in a Super Bowl commercial. Suzy Kolber huddles with two fiercely determined women who paved flag football's path to the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics - and aren't stopping there.

programme.title: Savannah's Top Banana
programme.desc: Jesse Cole, the visionary owner of the Savannah Bananas, turned a failing college summer baseball team into a $500 million entertainment empire by doing the exact opposite of what everyone else did. Suzy Kolber traces how a man in a yellow tuxedo built a global phenomenon by asking a question nobody else was: What if the fans, and true fun are the whole point? Jesse opens up about being nearly $2 million in debt and the critics who were certain he was out of his mind - right up until he wasn't.

programme.title: Shaquille O'Neal
programme.desc: Shaquille O'Neal, who went from being poor and bullied to NBA stardom, reveals how his stepfather taught him the valuable lesson that "true pressure is not knowing where your next meal is coming from."

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Trenton and Trevor pack up and drive down to Arkansas for their first experience on the White River. The brothers spend a day in the boat with Bryant Stark of Rising Rivers, fishing the White and the Norfork. Though the White is much larger waters than back home, Trevor utilizes his experience to catch them even while wading.

programme.title: West End Boatworks
programme.sub-title: West End Boatworks - "The Fish Behind the Boat"
programme.desc: Chris, Billy, and Capt. Austin Oskey take on Boca Grande for a day of tarpon fishing, putting in the time on the water while chasing some of the area’s hard-fighting fish. After a full day on the boat, they wrap up the trip with a well-earned plate of chicken wings.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.sub-title: The Raven Project - "50 Acres In 5 Days Part 2"
programme.desc: The boys are still at the Raven in Missouri trying to finish planting 50 acres of Big Tine food plots in 5 days. Then Randy heads to the Powder River in Montana and tries to knock down his first buck of the 2025 season.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.sub-title: The Raven Project - "Bow Camp 2025 at The Dirty Bird"
programme.desc: Randy is getting the last food plot of the season in down at the Dirty Bird in Oklahoma. Then opening day of the 2025 bow season starts off in an unusual way for the crew. Randy smokes a Hog and Nate Has a really close call with one of the target bucks.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.sub-title: Deer and Deer Hunting - "The Deer Of Texas"
programme.desc: Explore the fascinating history of exotic species in Texas, tracking how non-native wildlife populations have transformed the Lone Star landscape from early 20th-century introductions to today. The journey concludes at the historic Y.O. Ranch for an action-packed axis deer hunt in the Texas Hill Country.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.sub-title: Deer and Deer Hunting - "Timing Of The Rut"
programme.desc: Contributor Mark Kayser breaks down the whitetail rut and how you as a hunter can take advantage of the perfect timing.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by air and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Rex meets up with “Mr Crappie” Wally Marshall in Texas. Wally takes Rex to one of his secret spots to put the hammer on the crappie. Not only did they catch crappie, but nice largemouth and some top tier coppernose bluegill.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: The Crew heads to Rivers Lodge and Hunt Club in Kansas to fish strip pits. Trenton and Rex take on Mike and Nate in a 3 period mini tournament. With multiple species allowed including northern pike, the two teams are neck and neck after the first two periods. Due to bad weather on day 2, period 3 turned into a hour speed round where only keeper largemouth count.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of Salmon fishing and hunting black tail deer. Whilst traversing steep mountains in the company of Kodiak brown bears and taking on cold Alaskan waters, Andy presents useful information for fellow outdoor enthusiasts all whilst building friendships with the great people of Kodiak Big Timber Lodge.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 1 of the British episodes, Andy starts his road trip around the United Kingdom in the Cotswolds where he sets out to hunt and taste the beautiful venison that Michelin star chef, Mark Robinson has to offer. He then proceeds to travel to the border of Scotland where he samples some of the finest and most historic bird shooting practices found throughout the British Isles.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch’ stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: We listen to guides and anglers on how they attempt to hook into the migrating tarpon that pass thru PCB’s beautiful beach waters each summer. It’s a lesson in humility, respect and yes....luck.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Water quality is everything—and the Star brite - SeaSafe team is back at it for the second year in a row! Led by Cory Redwine, Conservation Director of Project SeaSafe, this is the 4th Annual Clean Water Collective and it’s bigger than ever. This time, we’re in Grant, Florida, where 4 million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon, paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash clean ups to help restore one of Florida’s most critical ecosystems. But it’s not just about hard work—it’s about connection. With local captains, fishing legends, and the Local Knowledge crew on hand, we hit the water to show why this place is worth fighting for. From clam drops by drone, to in-water mangrove planting, to monster snook catches, this is hands-on conservation at its best. This two-part series kicks off with action, heart, and the kind of hope only a healthy waterway can bring. Don’t miss Part 1—where conservation meets community and everyone gets their hands wet.

programme.sub-title: Where, Oh, Where Has Our Blueberry Gone?

She decorates her store with Patti posters and rearranges her shelves to make room for all the Patti books she's ordered. Blueberry begins to neglect outings with her friends and even goes so far as to dress like her idol just to emulate her. She then starts looking for cases to solve around town.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake's Berry Bitty Adventures
programme.desc: While in the midst of a cake decorating demonstration at the café, the girls are uncharacteristically interrupted by an excited Princess Berrykin. She announces the Berrykins have decided to revive the old tradition of the Berry Bitty Buggy Derby. While the girls enthusiastically recount the stories they've heard about it and ask the Princess questions, Blueberry, carrying enough books to block her view, comes through the door and unknowingly interrupts the Princess.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake's Berry Bitty Adventures
programme.desc: The grove around Berry Bitty City is abuzz with activity. The Berrykins are using their sparkles to harvest berries, Berrykin Bloom is in his garden spraying flowers with a special solution to make them larger, and Raspberry is nearby gathering flower petals to make perfume. The wind starts to blow and picks up some of the sparkles. The sparkles float along the wind and get combined with some of Berrykin Bloom's solution.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake's Berry Bitty Adventures
programme.desc: It's time again for the Dance-Off between the Big Bitty City Dance Team and the Berry Bitty City Dancers. Plum is stressed out and frazzled because she desperately wants to win. And the Big Bitty City Dancers are a force to be reckoned with. They are elegant and beautifully synchronized. Plum shows the girls a maze of dance steps that she's choreographed in the hopes of creating a winning piece. The problem is, the contest is only 1 week away!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake's Berry Bitty Adventures
programme.desc: The girls are all gathered at the café. Strawberry is experimenting making applesauce from scratch with a mallet (and making a mess) while the rest busily make their own wrapping paper and bows for the annual gift exchange they hold in celebration of First Frost. Mr. Longface stops by and Strawberry offers him some fresh applesauce but he declines, as he doesn't care for it. He's only there for some tea and, being that he's new in town, doesn't know what the group is up to.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake's Berry Bitty Adventures
programme.desc: Raspberry is distraught when she suspects her friends have copied her design on her lantern for the "Glimmerberry Gathering".

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake's Berry Bitty Adventures
programme.desc: While sipping cider in Strawberry's café, the girls muse about how they cannot wait for winter to arrive. They list the various traditions they love about the season but the one they all agree on is the Glimmerberry Ball. Strawberry mentions that she doesn't think the café can hold the party this year because of how the town has grown. The girls decide to split up and search for a new location.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake's Berry Bitty Adventures
programme.desc: Lemon is ecstatic. She races out of her salon and goes around to the other girls' houses proclaiming that she "did it!" and beckoning them to join her. They follow her back and are completely dazzled by her newest creation - Glamicures. They are brightly colored, jeweled manicures with tiny microchips inside that play songs when the wearer moves her hand. Each girl lines up to receive her new glamicure and soon there is a cacophony of color and sound.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake's Berry Bitty Adventures
programme.desc: While working in her store, Orange overhears the Berrykins laughing and shouting outside. When she goes to the door to investigate, a clump of dandelion fluff gets blown inside chased by three Berrykins. She watches as they head butt the clump around until it floats back toward Orange. Just as it floats close, she gives it a bat sending it outside and the Berrykins happily chasing after it. Wanting in on the fun, she joins them.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake's Berry Bitty Adventures

She made a secret recording of her niece, the child’s mother, D’Lanny Chairez, who insisted that she placed her son for adoption. But James' great aunt says she wasn’t buying it, and when she went into D’Lanny’s home to search for James, she says what she found horrified her -- a terrible smell and a bloody blanket that police believe came from the baby’s crib. Was D’Lanny telling the truth about her son’s whereabouts? Don’t miss the shocking update.
